Home / Media / Video

Video

Video embeds HTML5 video players with support for posters, native controls, responsive aspect ratios, captions, and card integration.

Basic Video Player

A minimal video element without explicit controls.

HTML
<video class="zak-video" src="video.mp4"></video>

Video with Poster

Show a poster image before the video begins playing.

HTML
<video class="zak-video" controls poster="poster.jpg">
  <source src="video.mp4" type="video/mp4">
</video>

Video with Controls

Enable native browser playback controls including play/pause, volume, and fullscreen.

HTML
<video class="zak-video" controls>
  <source src="video.mp4" type="video/mp4">
</video>

Responsive Video (16:9)

A video that scales to its container while maintaining the 16:9 aspect ratio.

HTML
<div class="zak-video-responsive zak-video-16by9">
  <video controls>
    <source src="video.mp4" type="video/mp4">
  </video>
</div>

<!-- Also available: .zak-video-4by3, .zak-video-1by1, .zak-video-21by9 -->

Video with Caption

Add closed captions using a WebVTT track and display a caption below.

Documentary: Life in the Ocean
A look at marine ecosystems, 2024
HTML
<video class="zak-video" controls>
  <source src="video.mp4" type="video/mp4">
  <track src="subtitles.vtt" kind="captions" srclang="en" label="English">
</video>
<figcaption class="zak-video-caption">
  <strong>Documentary</strong> A look at marine ecosystems
</figcaption>

Video in Card

Embed a video within a card component for a media-rich content block.

Product Launch Video

Watch our latest product announcement and see the new features in action.

HTML
<div class="zak-card">
  <video class="zak-video" controls>
    <source src="video.mp4" type="video/mp4">
  </video>
  <div class="zak-card-body">
    <h3 class="zak-card-title">Product Launch Video</h3>
    <p class="zak-card-text">Watch our latest announcement...</p>
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary zak-btn-sm">Watch Now</button>
  </div>
</div>

CSS Classes Reference

Class Description
.zak-videoBase video element
.zak-video-responsiveMaintains aspect ratio wrapper
.zak-video-16by916:9 aspect ratio
.zak-video-4by34:3 aspect ratio
.zak-video-1by11:1 aspect ratio
.zak-video-21by921:9 aspect ratio
.zak-video-captionCaption below video

Accessibility

  • Provide a <track kind="captions"> for spoken dialogue so content is accessible.
  • Include a visible text transcript as an alternative for users who cannot watch.
  • Support keyboard: play/pause with Space, seek with arrow keys, and Escape to exit fullscreen.
  • Never autoplay video with sound; if autoplay is used, mute and show a visible play button.
  • Ensure custom control buttons have aria-label describing their function.
